MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The memory-card and USB-reader bundle partly fits my interest in practical computer accessories because the reader helps move files between devices.",
    "That reader connects to the usefulness of my past USB accessories, though I would only choose it if I actually needed to transfer files from a memory card."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Smart speakers, smart plugs, and the car voice assistant solve needs I have not expressed; buying connection adapters does not mean I want an Alexa setup.",
    "Streaming sticks and a home camera do not help with the computer connections reflected in my recent purchases.",
    "Memory cards alone need a specific storage use, and the AirPods require a listening or replacement need and device compatibility that my history does not establish."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The suggestions treat interest in electronic accessories as interest in many kinds of electronic devices, even when their purposes differ.",
    "Several widely purchased devices appear despite having little connection to the practical problems my purchases addressed."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent adapters and cable point toward connecting existing equipment, adding ports, and getting reliable wired network access.",
    "My purchases are spread far apart and seem tied to specific needs; owning one accessory does not mean I currently need related products.",
    "The connections and devices an accessory supports matter more to me than simply being another electronic product."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognize my interest in electronics but mostly miss my specific, occasional need to connect and extend equipment I already use."
}
